content:
Let the disk have radius \(r\). Since \(AB\) is a diameter, the lower semicircle has central angle \(180^\circ\).

The shaded sector’s central angle is therefore
\[
\theta=180^\circ-30^\circ-40^\circ=110^\circ.
\]
(The \(65^\circ\) ray lies inside the shaded sector and does not affect its total area.)

Thus,
\[
P=\frac{\text{area of sector}}{\text{area of disk}}
=\frac{\frac{110}{360}\pi r^2}{\pi r^2}
=\frac{110}{360}
=\boxed{\frac{11}{36}}.
\]
